replies.author: toketrain
replies.body:
nice map :D

to copy using mcedit, select the quadrant that's finished. make sure to get all of it, but nothing other than the quadrant. click copy, then an icon will appear in the top right corner. click the picture in the icon, or click paste, then hit mirror. that will make it able to go into the quadrant next to it with the correct position. if it's not in the right place exactly, no worries, all you have to do is click the green "nudge" button and start clicking w,a,s,d,q, or z. when it's in the exact right place click import. to get the other two, click rotate twice and import it into the correct empty quadrant. this will turn it around so it faces the right way. now you can do that again for the last one. hit mirror again, and import it into the last quadrant. sorry if this is confusing :p

The thing on that picture that I don't like is the bushes on the right. I think a fence would fit in better instead of just leaves.


Another thing I just saw is in the top left corner of the picture, you seem to be missing some sand. I'm not sure if its the same in the download.


Overall pretty nice map. Good aesthetics. Nice balance between flat and not flat. Good job!

replies.author: Murphh
replies.body:
@ build_high - Thank you. I like your advice about the color scheme and keeping to a theme.  The theme was summer camp or going away to some type of camp where you learn a certain skill.  Most of the rooms/areas tie-in with the theme:
 * surface - cabins, mess hall, high ropes course, archery range, horseshoe pit, camper garden, etc..
 * main camps below - camp redstone, cook, weapons, potions, and enchants
 * other rooms - shrine to fallen campers, recreation room, trading room with villagers, challenge courses (like lava, minecart, canoe, parkour), garden shed, ice rink, restrooms, firepit, camper/counselor grave sites, underwater garden, blacksmith, maze of doom, storage room, tent cabins, place for team killers, etc...
There is a room with a nether theme, but I added it for the nether wart.  I admit that one doesn't really tie in.
The cabin colors were different to give the effect of different groups within the camp (like the way the wizard school in harry potter has 4 groups).

@matic0basle- Thank you for the feedback.  I can change the leaves to a fence.  I will make sure all the sand is in place before submission.

Please keep the comments coming, positive or negative.  Feedback is welcome!
